alternative_explanations: Any gain may come from generic hierarchical nearest-neighbor indexing or extra dimension/state rather than VSA algebra or learning.
confounds: Bucket balance, codebook randomness, noise rate, oracle leakage, dimension mismatch, uncharged centroid training, prototype state, bytes touched, update replacement, or per-step composition could create a false advantage; matched ratio-32 variants share byte-identical codes and superposition memory, and all costs are recorded.
falsification_criteria: Make HYP-0005 dormant if learned routing falls below 0.95 accuracy on any replicated K/depth regime, is dominated by the identical-representation classical bucket router or exact dictionary after fit/state/update/workload accounting, or the capacity gain requires dimension growth that removes the cost advantage.

outcome_policy.negative: Persistent capacity failure or dominance by exact/classical controls would make this VSA family dormant and redirect the portfolio.
outcome_policy.null: Equivalent learned and classical routing would attribute the cleanup gain to ordinary indexing and leave no evidence for a learned VSA-specific successor principle.
outcome_policy.positive: Evidence would support HYP-0005 only if learned routing uniquely improves the replicated full-system Pareto frontier while preserving robust unseen composition.

predicted_outcome: Global ratio-8 VSA will cross a capacity boundary; ratio-32 will recover accuracy at increased state, and routing will reduce cleanup comparisons. A genuinely useful learned router must exceed the matched classical bucket router rather than merely reproduce its partition.
promotion_criteria: Replicate at least 0.95 cold, warm, and noisy accuracy on all three seeds and all K/depth cells; learned routing must be non-dominated, reduce fully charged workload or state versus exact dictionary and classical bucket routing, retain updates, show a favorable scaling signature, and pass integrity/prior-art checks before promotion.
research_question: Does learned local cleanup preserve noisy multi-step VSA composition across K=8/32/128 with lower fully charged query and workload cost than identical-representation global cleanup, classical bucket routing, dense associative storage, and an exact dictionary?
title: Routed VSA capacity scaling with full cleanup accounting
